newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-McIntosh up again on takeover talk.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-McIntosh up again on takeover talk.

text.p: The shares of stock broker McIntosh Securities Ltd rose further on Friday on continuing speculation that the company was a takeover target.
At 11.15 a.m. (0015 GMT), McIntosh shares were eight cents higher at a 1996 high of A$1.18 on light volume of 24,500.

Market sources said McIntosh was believed to have held talks with a number of overseas brokers in the last six months, including U.S. securities house Merrill Lynch and Co about possible partnerships or joint ventures.
A spokeman from Merrill Lynch said it was the company's policy not to comment on market rumours.
On Thursday, McIntosh chief executive John McGowan said he had no comment on the rumour.
McIntosh is one of only two listed Australian brokers, the other being Perth-based Hartley Poynton Ltd.

McIntosh, which is 19.9 percent owned by Dutch bank and insurance group Internationale Nederlanden Groep (ING), reported a net profit of A$10.05 million for 1995/96 compared with a net loss of A$7.04 million a year earlier.
